caption: The drawing depicts a carved figure standing on a wooden pedestal. The figure is dressed in a red garment with yellow trim, which includes a draped cloak and skirt. The figure has medium-brown skin, black boots, and long, straight black hair. Around the neck, there appears to be a yellow necklace or necklaces. The figure’s right hand is bent at the elbow and pointing forward, while the left hand holds a bundle of cylindrical objects, likely cigars, alongside a rectangular brown box. On the head is a grey headdress or feathered hat with three large, rounded plumes. The pedestal below the figure is rectangular and brown, depicted with shaded lines to suggest wood grain and structure. The background is plain and light beige, with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Cigar Store Indian
